Workmind | Senior Backend Engineer | Bangkok, TH | Remote | Full Time

Workmind is a startup that builds AI-powered automation software for franchises and multi-location businesses, and we are growing quickly.

We are hiring 1 - 2 new backend developers to help build new features on our product. We're a small engineering team based in Southeast Asia, and we're looking for engineers with a track record of excellence who can hit the ground running.

View the full job description and application instructions here: https://workmind.cloud/jobs/backend-dev/
